generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Bidders are bond the guidelines / instructions issued time to from the government
Final bill will be admitted only after the submission of 3rd party report handing over certificate and completion report
If any date in the tender time table is government holidays, nest working date will be considered
Corrigendums / modifications / correction if any will be published in the website only
The Department is not responsible for any delay in accessing KPPP portal
The Employer reserves the rights to reject any of all tenders without assigning any reason
Conditional tenders will not be accepted

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: The Tenderer shall have valid class - IV KPWD / CPWD
In any one financial year out of last 5 financial years 2021-22 to 2025-26 Turn over Certificate Certified by Chartered Accountant with UDIN Number compulsory

As prime contractor at least one any construction of work such as of value not less than 25 percentage of amount put tender last 5 financial years 2021-22 to 2025-26 not below rank of Executive Engineer
Assessed available tender capacity computed as per the formula in section 3.6
Reserved Category Certificate CAT II A Bidders only
after reading the terms and conditions as per the bid documents. submit the bidders declaration on a letterhead

itemList.description: Work 1: Rejuvenation and Repairs of 50 KL OHT at Rikkin Alur Habitation in Aland Taluka (A.A. Sl. 16) - Finishing walls with textured exterior paint of required shade :Old work (Two coats on existing cement paint surface applied at 3.28 l/10 m2 including preparing the surface after thoroughly cleaning the surface to remove all dirt, dust and foreign matter, cost of materials, labour complete as per specifications and as per directions of Engineer-in-charge (Commen SR 2023-24, Volume-II, It. No-8.73.1 P.No.-53) [Commen SR 2023-24, Volume-II, It. No-8.73.1 P.No.-53]

Cleaning of Water Storage Tank or Sump by following method: (1) Empty the Tank/ Sump and make it to near dry, (2) Apply blEaching powder uniformally ( at Tank capacity x 0.5 gms/litre) inside the Tank/ Sump and wait for one hour, (3) After one hour, clean/ rinse the Tank/ Sump with fresh water. Repeat the process (2) and (3) for two to three times, all complete, as directed by the Engineer-in--Charge. SR 2023-24, Volume-V, It. No-18.4 P.No.-221 [SR 2023-24, Volume-V, It. No-18.4 P.No.-221]

Providing and fixing 40mm dia. GI pipe medium duty pipes hand railing 3 rows fixed to RCC 1:2:4 vibrated post of 150x150mm at bottom and 100x150mm at top, placed at 2 Mtrs. intervals for a height of 750mm including curing, painting GI pipes with two coats of anticorrosive steel paint over a primer coat etc. with all lead lift etc. (The rate per meter is for 3 rows of GI pipes and RCC post) (Commen SR 2023-24, Volume-V, It. No-7.8 P.No.-87) [Commen SR 2023-24, Volume-V, It. No-7.8 P.No.-87]

Providing and Applying single component Polyurethane based cold applied seamless waterproofing coating to the RCC surface like Roof and Podium area applied at 2.4kg/m2 in 3 coats to achieve 1.5mm DFT, including a prime coat of solvent free, medium viscous, epoxy primer at 0.2L/m2 and protection with 120gsm Geo-textile over the 7 days cured waterproofing membrane. The Waterproofing material shall have Solids 85%, Tensile strength 2 Mpa as per ASTM D 412, Elongation at break 400% confirms to ASTM C 1305 for crack bridging ability (no cracks up to 3.2mm) Shore A Hardness 55 as per ASTM D 2240, Adhesion to peel after water immersion as per ASTM C 794 at 5.2N. Resistance to root penetration as per UNE CN/ TS 14416. The finished cost to include surface preparation, making coving of 50 mm X 50mm at all right angles of wall Junction with Polymer Repair Mortar and lay 60gsm Geo-textile over the angle fillet when the first coat in still wet, treatment of cracks completely as per specification. (Commen SR 2023-24, Volume-II, It. No-15.12 P.No.-152) [Commen SR 2023-24, Volume-II, It. No-15.12 P.No.-152]

Providing 20 mm cement plaster of mix :1:4 (1 cement: 4 fine sand) to brick/stone masonry including rounding off corners wherever required smooth rendering, providing and removing scaffolding, including cost of materials, labour, curing complete as per specifications and as per directions of Engineer-in-charge. Commen SR 2023-24, Volume-II, It. No-8.3.1 P.No.-41 [Commen SR 2023-24, Volume-II, It. No-8.3.1 P.No.-41]

Providing and laying in position Cement Concrete for levelling course for all works in foundation. The granite/trap/basalt crushed graded coarse aggregates and fine aggregates as per relevant IS Codes ma chine mixed, laid in layers not exceeding 150 mm thickness, well com pacted using plate vibrators, including all lead and lifts, cost of all materi als of quality, labour, Usage charges of machineries, curing, and all the other appurtenances required to complete the work as per technical specifications. Mix 1:4:8 Using 40 mm nominal size graded crushed coarse aggregates. [Commen SR 2023-24. Volume-1. It: No-2.1.2 P.No.-15]
